name: X调度员
tagline: Sends X tasks down the cheaper route so your developer credits last longer
description: A cost-control layer for anyone running a lot of automated work on X. Jobs that would otherwise burn through metered quota get pushed onto a local execution path instead, with lookups carried out on the machine and browser session the bot itself controls, so signing in happens there rather than via the API.
author: cgnot996
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
